# Self-hosted Object Storage: References

Always prefer current vendor and project documentation. The MinIO community edition's status changed
several times in 2025–2026, so re-check the repository and vendor pages every time this skill is used or
updated, and record the date checked.

Last verified: 2026-10-31

## Vendor and project (authoritative)

### MinIO

- Community edition repository (README carries the maintenance and source-only notices; archived, read-only
  at the time of review): https://github.com/minio/minio
- Community repository security advisories: https://github.com/minio/minio/security/advisories
- MinIO client (`mc`) repository: https://github.com/minio/mc
- MinIO documentation portal (AIStor and related products; community docs may no longer be hosted
  here): https://docs.min.io/
- AIStor product overview: https://min.io/product/aistor-overview

### Garage

- Configuration reference (ports, `rpc_secret`, `admin_token`, `metrics_token`):
  https://garagehq.deuxfleurs.fr/documentation/reference-manual/configuration/
- S3 compatibility status (versioning, object lock, bucket policies):
  https://garagehq.deuxfleurs.fr/documentation/reference-manual/s3-compatibility/
- Project site and releases: https://garagehq.deuxfleurs.fr/

### SeaweedFS

- Security overview (JWT signing, gRPC mTLS, `security.toml`):
  https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/wiki/Security-Overview
- S3 credentials (allow-all mode until an identity exists):
  https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/wiki/S3-Credentials
- Amazon S3 API overview: https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/wiki/Amazon-S3-API
- Repository and releases: https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs

### Ceph RADOS Gateway

- RGW documentation: https://docs.ceph.com/en/latest/radosgw/
- Ceph security and past vulnerabilities: https://docs.ceph.com/en/latest/security/

### S3 API semantics

- AWS S3 Object Lock concepts (governance vs. compliance, legal hold), which most compatible servers
  follow: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html
- AWS S3 Versioning: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents.

## Third-party (not authoritative)

- Blocks and Files, June 2025, on the removal of admin features from the community console:
  https://blocksandfiles.com/2025/06/19/minio-removes-management-features-from-basic-community-edition-object-storage-code/
  Useful for the timeline; dates differ between sources.
- Linuxiac, on the end of active community development:
  https://linuxiac.com/minio-ends-active-development/
- Fork author's account of the community edition's end and a fork that restores the console and binaries:
  https://vonng.com/en/db/minio-resurrect/
  Written by a fork maintainer; treat claims about the fork as the maintainer's own.
- Community fork that restored the console (OpenMaxIO) is reported in the Blocks and Files coverage above.
  Its current maintenance status was not verified for this review.
